subject: Cohort slate conversion & credits escape hatch
messages:
From: Emma Park <emma@launchbridge.co>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Remaining cohort credits — can we convert some to ongoing pilot funding?

Sergio / Ben —

Thanks again for the kickoff session last week. Quick question from our finance lead: we have ~$38k of unused cohort credits from cohort Q2 that we expected to expire. Given the momentum on our pilot apps, would Redwood consider converting up to 60% of those remaining credits into a short-term committed discount or apply them toward a Dedicated pilot (to be invoiced)?

We'd prefer a path that:
- Preserves some promotional benefit for the cohort organizers
- Lets us start a small dedicated pool with predictable spend
- Keeps procurement paperwork minimal (PO acceptable)

Attached a simple usage extract for the cohort so you can see the balance. Happy to jump on a call if that helps.

Best,
Emma Park
Partnerships, LaunchBridge Labs
LaunchBridge Labs | emma@launchbridge.co

Attachment: LaunchBridge_Cohort_Usage.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@launchbridge.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Remaining cohort credits — can we convert some to ongoing pilot funding?

Emma —

Appreciate the context and the usage extract. Short answer: yes, we can offer a one-time conversion path, but we need to lock the mechanics so finance/ops can invoice cleanly and we don't set an open precedent for unlimited conversions. Proposal (high level):

1) Convert up to 60% of unused promo credits to a 3-month committed discount applied to a Dedicated pilot. Conversion cap = $22,800 (60% of $38k).
2) Customer can choose: a) converted-credit applied as prepayment toward Dedicated spend (invoiced monthly), or b) a time-limited discount code applied to hosted consumption for 90 days.
3) This exception requires a short amendment (billing ops only), PO accepted, and a single signature from LaunchBridge. No change to SLAs.

I'll attach a one-page conversion term sheet for ops to review and run by Marissa for accounting treatment. If this works in principle, happy to schedule an ops handoff call today or tomorrow.

If Ben or Marissa have immediate redlines, drop them inline.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com

Attachment: convert-proposal-v1.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

From: Emma Park <emma@launchbridge.co>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Nolan <chris@founderspark.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Remaining cohort credits — can we convert some to ongoing pilot funding?

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Sergio — that approach looks reasonable. A few clarifying notes from our side:

- We prefer option (a) and would use the converted amount to spin up a two-GPU Dedicated pilot for internal PoCs.
- Procurement: PO is best; our procurement team will need an invoice timeline and the amendment language.
- Accounting question: will converted credit show as a discount line or as applied prepayment? Either is fine, but need the description for our ledger.

I've looped Chris from FoundersPark (they co-sponsor the cohort) — they are ok with the conversion in principle but need the final wording for their finance team.

Happy to sign the amendment once Marissa confirms billing flows.

Best,
Emma

- Tax treatment for the conversion (LaunchBridge is US-based).
- If we go with Dedicated prepay, we need a SKU/line item for the two-GPU pilot.

Emma / Sergio / Ben —

Thanks for the thread. Finance confirms we can support the conversion as a one-time prepayment path with these constraints:

- Converted amount will be booked as a customer prepayment (liability) on Redwood books and applied against Dedicated invoices monthly until exhausted.
- We will issue a single invoice on PO receipt for $22,800 with description: "Cohort credit conversion — applied to Dedicated pilot".
- No refunds for any unused portion after 90 days; unused balance will be forfeited per the amendment.
- We will provide a one-page amendment (billing-only); legal changes minimal.

Next steps:
1) Sergio/Ben to confirm pilot SKU and monthly billing cadence.
2) LaunchBridge to issue PO referencing deal RDW-2025-1487.
3) I'll prepare invoice and the one-page amendment; will send DocuSign link when ready.

If that all works, send me the PO and I'll queue the invoice.

—Marissa
